BL-833 — Host-agent activity feed — tee the progress lines the host agent already emits into a bounded per-session feed the bridge serves, so a client other than Telegram can watch a turn happen
What it solves: ## e2e procedure for QA
Approval context: Two things worth the human's eye.
(1) **Redaction is deliberately absent**, with the reasoning above: nothing exists to inherit, and the feed exposes no line that is not already going to Telegram under the same principal. If the human would rather have a redaction pass before any second consumer re…
BL-833 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-833" (or "reject BL-833 <reason>") to act.
